question: Find out how many actors have a 'Shahrukh number' of 2? This means they acted in a film with someone who acted with Shahrukh Khan, but not directly with him.
sql:
WITH srk_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.MID FROM M_Cast mc WHERE TRIM(mc.PID) = 'nm0451321'
),
direct_coactors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID) AS PID FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN srk_movies sm ON mc.MID = sm.MID
    WHERE TRIM(mc.PID) != 'nm0451321'
)
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID) AS coactor_pid, p.Name
FROM M_Cast mc
JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
JOIN direct_coactors dc ON TRIM(mc.PID) = dc.PID
WHERE mc.MID IN ('tt2388771', 'tt1010048', 'tt3823392', 'tt1836987')
LIMIT 10
